description.value: This study examined smoking cue and mental simulation-related regional brain activity and hub-based functional connectivity changes in male smokers and non-smokers using functional MRI.

spans.text: Functional MRI was conducted on 30 smokers and 30 non-smokers while mentally simulating neutral and smoking hand movements.

value: We hypothesized that the SCC and PCC would show functional connectivity changes with the salience and reward network nodes by smoking-cue induced attentional state transition in smokers

Mental simulation task and scanning procedure

description.value: Participants mentally simulated acting according to pictures of neutral and smoking hand movements, with visual fixation blocks between cue blocks.

spans.text: Before scanning, participants were instructed to imagine that they were acting according to the pictures of hand movements during the neutral and smoking cue blocks and to not think about anything in particular while staring at the crosshair in the visual fixation block.
smoking cue
In a neutral or smoking cue block, 3 cue pictures were randomly non-repeatedly imported from the corresponding cue picture set and consecutively presented for 8 s per picture.

description.value: Five smoking cue blocks were presented; each block contained three randomly selected, non-repeated smoking-related pictures, each shown for 8 seconds. Participants mentally simulated acting according to the pictured smoking-related hand movements.

spans.text: We selected 18 smoking cue pictures showing a hand holding a cigarette at different positions and angles
neutral cue

description.value: Five neutral cue blocks were presented; each block contained three randomly selected, non-repeated neutral hand/object pictures, each shown for 8 seconds. Participants mentally simulated acting according to the pictured neutral hand movements.

description.value: Functional MRI preprocessing and activation analysis were performed in SPM12. The first four volumes were discarded, slice timing was corrected, images were realigned, the T1 image was coregistered, images were normalized to MNI space and smoothed with a 6-mm FWHM Gaussian kernel; a 1/128-Hz high-pass filter was applied. Functional-connectivity preprocessing used CONN toolbox version 18a with CompCor denoising, white-matter and CSF nuisance regressors, realignment parameters, band-pass filtering at or above 0.01 Hz, detrending, and despiking.
